# DEPLOY1 read-only security / deployment review

**Verdict: not APPROVED** — actionable **P1** and **P2** items below. Architecture matches the packet (dual build, hub/search client `searchParams`, park/restore proxy, manifest + leak scan). No **P0** blockers found for a clean CI `build:pages` + `smoke:pages` path when the wrapper completes normally.

---

## Park / restore (`build-pages.mjs`)

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| **P1** | `platform/apps/web/scripts/build-pages.mjs:84–101`, `134–141` | `patchDynamicParams()` can patch some of the six routes then throw (disk, unexpected content). `paramsPatched` is only set after the full loop, so `finally` skips `restoreDynamicParams()` and leaves a mix of `dynamicParams = false` + `.pages-bak` files — **normal `build`/`dev` / `smoke:web-routes` regression** until manual restore. | On any failure inside `patchDynamicParams`, call `restoreDynamicParams()` before rethrowing; or set `paramsPatched = true` as soon as the first `.pages-bak` is written and always restore in `finally`. |
| **P2** | `platform/apps/web/scripts/build-pages.mjs:134–159` | `finally` restores on normal exit/failure, but **SIGKILL** or hard kill mid-patch can skip cleanup (same corruption as above). | Document ops recovery (delete partial patches, restore from `*.pages-bak`); optional `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM` handlers that invoke the same restore path. |
| **P2** | `platform/apps/web/scripts/build-pages.mjs:66–69` | Stale `proxy.ts.pages-disabled` blocks the next run (`Refusing to overwrite…`) — easy after interrupted build. | Document recovery; consider auto-restore when `proxy.ts` is missing and parked file exists. |
| OK | `62–82`, `156–158` | Happy-path proxy park/restore; refuses double-park / double-bak. | — |
| OK | `17–19` (workflow) | `concurrency.cancel-in-progress` limits overlapping deploys; local parallel `build:pages` still guarded by park checks. | — |

---

## Static export route set

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| OK | `smoke-pages.mjs:106–141`, `144–157` | Manifest derived from `learner-projection.json` + `learner-details.json`: 2 lessons, 23 activities, 3 details, 7 games, hubs, search, practice/conversation roots + representative conversation entity — aligns with **48** routes and on-disk `out/**/index.html` (encoded `activity%3A…`, `lex%3A…`, `qa%3A…`). | — |
| **P3** | `smoke-pages.mjs:318–332` | HTTP smoke omits e.g. `/concepts/`, second lesson activity, raw-colon alias (packet allows omitting redirect on Pages). | Optional: add `/concepts/` and one encoded activity URL to `must200`. |

---

## `basePath` (Link / forms / assets / RSC)

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| OK | `next.config.ts:33–40`, `build-pages.mjs:148–151` | Export sets `basePath` + `assetPrefix` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_GL_PAGES_BASE_PATH` together. | — |
| OK | `pages-base-path.ts:17–22`, `HubViews.tsx:217`, `SearchViews.tsx:118` | Raw HTML `form action` uses `withPagesBasePath`; `next/link` stays app-relative (Next applies `basePath`). | — |
| OK | `AppShell.tsx`, `not-found.tsx` | Nav/dashboard links app-relative. | — |
| **P2** | `next.config.ts:26–27` vs `pages-base-path.ts:9–10` | Running `GL_PAGES_EXPORT=1` **without** `NEXT_PUBLIC_GL_PAGES_BASE_PATH` (bypassing `build-pages.mjs`) prefixes server assets via `PAGES_BASE_PATH` but client `withPagesBasePath` stays empty → **broken hub/search GET forms** on Pages. | Fail fast in `next.config` when `GL_PAGES_EXPORT=1` and public base unset; or only allow export via `build:pages`. |

---

## Request-time features / 404

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| OK | `HubRoutePage.tsx`, `search/page.tsx`, `HubNavViews.tsx`, `SearchNavViews.tsx` | Hubs/search: static server shell + `useSearchParams` under `Suspense`; filters/back via `nav` preserved. | — |
| OK | No app `route.ts` / `use server` in web app source | Static export compatible. | — |
| OK | `not-found.tsx`, `build-pages.mjs:114–128`, `smoke-pages.mjs:353–382` | Honest 404; smoke checks unknown route doesn’t leak activity prompt. | — |
| OK | Packet + worker report | Raw-colon **308** omitted without proxy on Pages; canonical encoded routes exported. | — |

---

## Workflow (trigger / permissions / artifacts / supply chain)

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| OK | `deploy-pages.yml:6–10` | `push` → `codex/live-alpha`, `workflow_dispatch`. | — |
| OK | `deploy-pages.yml:12–15` | `contents: read`, `pages: write`, `id-token: write`; no `secrets.*`. | — |
| OK | `deploy-pages.yml:57–60` | Upload **only** `platform/apps/web/out`. | — |
| **P2** | `deploy-pages.yml:29`, `32`, `55`, `58`, `64` | Actions use floating majors (`checkout@v4`, `setup-node@v4`, `configure-pages@v5`, `upload-pages-artifact@v3`, `deploy-pages@v4`) — supply-chain drift. | Pin to full commit SHAs (Dependabot-renewable). |
| **P2** | `deploy-pages.yml:42–52` | CI runs `check` + `build:pages` + `smoke:pages` only — **not** `build:web` / `smoke:web-routes` (packet gate list includes those for release honesty). | Add post-check job steps or required branch protection on full gate script before merge to `codex/live-alpha`. |

---

## Secrets / private / review / media

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| OK | `smoke-pages.mjs:60–93`, `200–227` | Recursive scan for secrets, dev paths, review/assertion keys, `.mp3`, forbidden path segments under `out/`. | — |
| OK | `media-availability.ts`, packet §8 | Build-time manifest lookup; approved `assetId` only; no copy of `resources/original` / samples into workflow inputs. | — |
| OK | `project-content.ts` | Projects from `platform/content/published` only. | — |

---

## Pages compatibility (colon / trailing slash)

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| OK | `next.config.ts:36`, `out/` layout | `trailingSlash: true`; encoded segments on disk (`activity%3A…`). | — |
| OK | `smoke-pages.mjs:256–285`, `318–332` | Static server maps `/german-learning-exam/.../` to `out/.../index.html` (Pages-like). | — |
| **P3** | `smoke-pages.mjs` | No explicit HTTP check for **non-trailing-slash** URL under base (GH Pages + export usually OK via Next links). | Optional smoke for redirect or 404 behavior. |

---

## Smoke quality

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| **P2** | `smoke-pages.mjs:373–376` | Game hydration allows bare `/_next/` OR prefixed — **false pass** if HTML only had root-relative `_next` on real Pages. | Require `game.text.includes(\`${PAGES_BASE}/_next/\`)` (same bar as `194–196`). |
| OK | `190–197`, `344–351` | Sample HTML forbids bare `href="/_next/`; fetches a base-pathed static asset. | — |

---

## Normal build / dev regression (source design)

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| OK | Current source | `dynamicParams = true` on six patched routes; `proxy.ts` present; lesson page `dynamicParams = false` + `generateStaticParams` (intentional). | — |
| OK | `smoke-canonical-routes.mjs` | Still targets server build + proxy behavior (unchanged contract). | — |

---

## Unused residue (materiality)

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|--------|-----|
| **P3** | `platform/apps/web/lib/content/ssg-dynamic-params.ts:1–6` | Empty stub; **no imports** (worker report acknowledged). | Delete file. |
| **P2** | `platform/apps/web/.gitignore` | No `*.pages-bak` / `proxy.ts.pages-disabled` — build residue can be committed accidentally. | Add ignore patterns. |

---

## Summary

- **P0:** none identified for a completed wrapper + CI path.
- **P1:** partial `dynamicParams` patch without restore (`build-pages.mjs`).
- **P2:** workflow action pinning, CI gate gap vs `build:web`/`smoke:web-routes`, weak game `_next` assertion, `GL_PAGES_EXPORT` footgun, gitignore for park artifacts, interrupt/stale-park ops edge cases.

**Do not APPROVE** until at least the **P1** patch-restore issue is fixed; address **P2** items before treating DEPLOY1 as release-ready for `codex/live-alpha`.
